BANK-Prep.question: ১) Iqbal invested an amount of Tk. 21250 for 6 years. At what rate of simple interest will be obtain the total amount of Tk. 26350 at the end of 6 years?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: Iqbal invested an amount of Tk. 21250 for 6 years. At what rate of simple interest will be obtain the total amount of Tk. 26350 at the end of 6 years?

Solution:
Here, P = Tk. 21250,
Simple interest, I = Tk. (26350 - 21250) = Tk. 5100
Time, n = 6 years.

We know, 
I = Pnr
r = I/Pn
= {(5100 × 100)/(21250 × 6)}%
= 4%

BANK-Prep.question: ২) The compound interest on 300 tk. at 7% per annum is 21 taka. The period is:
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: The compound interest on 300 tk. at 7% per annum is 21 taka. The period is:

Solution: 
চক্রবৃদ্ধি সুদাসল = P (1 + r)n
= 300 + 21
= 321 tk.

প্রশ্নমতে,
321 = 300 × (1 + 7/100)n
⇒ (1 + 7/100)n = 321/300
⇒  (107/100)n = 107/100
⇒  (107/100)n = (107/100)1
∴ n = 1 year

BANK-Prep.question:
৩) What number will replace the '?' mark?
2, 4, 12, 48, 240, ?, 10080
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: What number will replace the '?' mark?
2, 4, 12, 48, 240, ?, 10080

Solution:
২য়, ৩য়, ৪র্থ, ৫ম, ৬ষ্ঠ সংখ্যাকে যথাক্রমে 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 দ্বারা ক্রমান্বয়ে গুণ করা হয়েছে।
2 × 2 = 4
4 × 3 = 12
12 × 4 = 48
48 × 5 = 240
240 × 6 = 1440
1440 × 7 = 10080

BANK-Prep.question: ৪) At what rate percent per annum will a sum of money double in 4 years?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: At what rate percent per annum will a sum of money double in 4 years?

Solution:
ধরি, সুদের হার r %

আসল x টাকা 
সুদাসল = 2x টাকা 
সুদ = 2x - x টাকা 
= x টাকা 

x = x × r × 4/100
∴ r = 25%

BANK-Prep.question: ৬) The population of a village decreases at the rate of 25% per annum. If its population 2 years ago was 24000, the present population is =?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: The population of a village decreases at the rate of 25% per annum. If its population 2 years ago was 24000, the present population is =?

Solution: 
Given that,
The population of a village 2 years ago = 24000
Rate of growth = 25% p.a.
Time period = 2 years

Present population = P{(1 - (r/100)}n
= 24000 × {1 - (25/100)}2
= 24000 × {1 - (1/4)}2
= 24000 × (3/4)2
= 24000 × (9/16)
= 13500

BANK-Prep.question: ৮) There is 60% increase in an amount in 6 years at simple interest. What will be the compound interest of Tk. 12,000 after 3 years at the same rate?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: There is 60% increase in an amount in 6 years at simple interest. What will be the compound interest of Tk. 12,000 after 3 years at the same rate?

Solution:
Let P = Tk. 100.
Then, S.I. Tk. = 60 and n = 6 years

Rate = (100 × 60)/(100 × 6) = 10%

Now, P = Tk. 12000
n = 3 years and R = 10% p.a.

C.I. = P (1 + r)n - P
= 12000{1 + (10/100)}3 - 12000
= 12000 (11/10)3 - 12000
= (12000 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10) - 12000
= 15972 - 12000
= Tk. 3972

∴ Compound interest Tk. 3972.

BANK-Prep.question: ৯) How much time will it take for an amount of Tk. 900 to yield Tk. 162 as interest at 9% per annum of simple interest?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: How much time will it take for an amount of Tk. 900 to yield Tk. 162 as interest at 9% per annum of simple interest?

Solution: 
I = Pnr
⇒ 162 = 900 × n × (9/100)
⇒ n = (162 × 100)/(900 × 9)
∴  n = 2 years.

BANK-Prep.question: ১০) A sum of Tk 7800 gives a simple interest of Tk. 702 in 2 years and 3 months. The rate of interest per annum is =?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: A sum of Tk 7800 gives a simple interest of Tk. 702 in 2 years and 3 months. The rate of interest per annum is =?

Solution:
Time = 2 years 3 months
= 2 + (3/12)
= 2 + (1/4)
= (8 + 1)/4
= 9/4 years

Here,
I = 702
P = 7800
n = 9/4
r = ?

We know,
I = Pnr
⇒ r = I/pn
⇒ r = (702 × 4 × 100)/(7800 × 9)
∴ r = 4%

BANK-Prep.question: ১১) A man starts from a point and travels 12 km in the north direction. Again he went east for 6 km and changed direction and again went north for 8 km. Finally went west for 6 km. What is the direct distance between his destination and journey?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: A man starts from a point and travels 12 km in the north direction. Again he went east for 6 km and changed direction and again went north for 8 km. Finally went west for 6 km. What is the direct distance between his destination and journey?

Solution:
 
ঐ ব্যক্তির যাত্রাস্থান A এবং গন্তব্য স্থান E
∴ তার গন্তব্য স্থান ও যাত্রা স্থানের সরাসরি দূরত্ব, AE = (12 + 8) কি.মি.

BANK-Prep.question: ১২) A sum of money at compound interest doubles itself in 15 years. It will become eight times of itself in-
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: A sum of money at compound interest doubles itself in 15 years. It will become eight times of itself in-

Solution: 
let the sum P 

2P = P (1 + r)15
⇒ (1 + r)15 = 2

let, sum will 8 times in n years
8P = P(1 + r)n
⇒ 8 = (1 + r)n
⇒ 23 = (1 + r)n
⇒ {(1 + r)15}3 = (1 + r)n
⇒ (1 + r)45 = (1 + r)n
∴ n = 45 years

BANK-Prep.question: ১৩) A clock seen through a mirror, shows quarter past three. What is the correct time shown by the clock?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: A clock seen through a mirror, shows quarter past three. What is the correct time shown by the clock?

Solution: 
The time quarter past 3 is 3 : 15

প্রকৃতপক্ষে সময় 
= 11 : 60 - আয়নায় দেখা সময় 
= 11 : 60 - 3 : 15
= 8 : 45

BANK-Prep.question: ১৪) A sum was put at simple interest at a certain rate for 3 years. Had it been put at 1% higher rate, it would have fetched 510 taka more. The sum is -
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: A sum was put at simple interest at a certain rate for 3 years. Had it been put at 1% higher rate, it would have fetched 510 taka more. The sum is - 

Solution: 
Let the sum be Tk x and original rate be R%

ATQ,
((x × (R +1) × 3)/100) - {(x × R × 3)/100} = 510
⇒ 3Rx + 3x - 3Rx = 51000
⇒ 3x = 51000
⇒ x = 17000

Hence, sum = Tk. 17,000

BANK-Prep.question: ১৫) Students of a class stand in a queue. If Raju is 22<sup>nd</sup> in order from both ends, how many students are there in the queue?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: Students of a class stand in a queue. If Raju is 22nd in order from both ends, how many students are there in the queue?

Solution:

BANK-Prep.question: ১৭) 4600 Taka is lent at compound interest of 10% per annum for 2 years. Find the amount after two years.
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: 4600 Taka is lent at compound interest of 10% per annum for 2 years. Find the amount after two years.

Solution:
Compound amount = P (1 + r)n
= 4600 {1 + (10/100)}2
= 4600 × (110/100) × (110/100)
= 46 × 11 × 11
= 5566

BANK-Prep.question: ১৮) A sum of Tk. 10,000 amounts to Tk. 12,000 in 4 years at the rate of simple interest. What is the rate of interest?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: A sum of Tk. 10,000 amounts to Tk. 12,000 in 4 years at the rate of simple interest. What is the rate of interest?

Solution: 
Interest = 12000 - 10000 = Tk. 2000

Let, interest rate = r%  

We know,
I = Pnr
⇒ 2000 = 10000 × 4 × r/100
⇒ r = 5

Interest rate 5%

BANK-Prep.question: ১৯) P is bigger than J. S is bigger than M. R is not as big as S but is bigger than J. M is not as big as J. Which is the smallest?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: P is bigger than J. S is bigger than M. R is not as big as S but is bigger than J. M is not as big as J. Which is the smallest?

Solution: 
P is bigger the J. ⇒ P > J
S is bigger than M. ⇒ S > M
R is not as big as S but is bigger than J. ⇒ S > R > J
M is not as big as J. ⇒ J > M

∴ M is the smallest.

BANK-Prep.question: ২০) A sum of money amounts to Tk. 5200 in 5 years and to Tk. 5680 in 7 years at simple interest. The rate of interest per annum is?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: A sum of money amounts to Tk. 5200 in 5 years and to Tk. 5680 in 7 years at simple interest. The rate of interest per annum is?

Solution:
Simple interest for 2 years = (5680 - 5200) Tk.
= Tk. 480
∴ Simple Interest for 2 years =  Tk. 480
∴ Simple Interest for 5 years =  Tk. (480 × 5/2)
= Tk. 1200
∴ Principal = 5200 - 1200 = Tk. 4000.

We know, 
I = Pnr
⇒ r = I/Pn
⇒ r = (1200 × 100)/(4000 × 5)
∴ r = 6%

BANK-Prep.question: ২১) What would be the compound interest accrued on an amount of Tk 10000 at the rate of 15% per annum in 2 years?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: What would be the compound interest accrued on an amount of Tk 10000 at the rate of 15% per annum in 2 years? 

Solution:
Compound Principal = 10000(1 + 15/100)2
= 10000 × (115/100)2
= (10000 × 115 × 115)/(100 × 100)
= 13225

Compound interest = 13225 - 10000 = Tk. 3225

BANK-Prep.question: ২২) What number will replace the '?' mark?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: What number will replace the '?' mark?

Solution:
নিচের ১ম সংখ্যা + নিচের দুই সংখ্যার পার্থক্য = উপরের সংখ্যা।

১ম চিত্রে, 30 + (30 - 15) = 45
তৃতীয় চিত্রে, 28 + (28 - 21) = 35

∴ দ্বিতীয় চিত্রে, 25 + (25 - 19) = 31

BANK-Prep.question: ২৩) Find the difference between the simple interest and the compound interest at 10% per annum for 2 years on a principal of Tk 3000.
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: Find the difference between the simple interest and the compound interest at 10% per annum for 2 years on a principal of Tk 3000.

Solution:
We know, Simple Interest, I = Pnr
and Compound Principal, C = p(1 + r)n

Simple Interest = 3000 × 2 × (10/100) = 600 Tk

Compound Principal = 3000 × {1 + (10/100)}2
= 3000 × (110/100)2
= (3000 × 110 × 110)/(100 × 100)
= 3630

So, Compound interest = 3630 - 3000 = 630 Tk

So, difference = 630 - 600 = 30 Tk.

BANK-Prep.question:
২৪) Which number will complete the series:
155, 151, 147, 143, 139, ........?
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: Which number will complete the series:
155, 151, 147, 143, 139, ........?

Solution:
The pattern is followed by
155 - 4 = 151
151 - 4 = 147
147 - 4 = 143
143 - 4 = 139
139 - 4 = 135

Hence the number= 135.

BANK-Prep.question: ২৫) A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Tk. 815 in 3 years and to Tk. 854 in 4 years. The sum is-
BANK-Prep.exp:
Question: A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Tk. 815 in 3 years and to Tk. 854 in 4 years. The sum is-

Solution:
Simple interest for 1 year = Tk. (854 - 815)
= Tk. 39

∴ Simple interest for 3 years = Tk.(39 × 3)
= Tk. 117

∴ Sum = (815 - 117)
= Tk. 698
